There is no toxicity present in this meme; it does not target any specific group based on race, gender, religion, or other protected characteristics. The humor is derived from the illogical and exaggerated premise, not from disparaging or harmful content. It is a common personal care product used to prevent sunburn and reduce the risk of skin cancer. The meme humorously equates the absence of hair (which cannot absorb UV rays) with the function of sunscreen, implying that the bald head is a 'natural sunscreen'.
